# nutanix_storage_container (Resource)

Manages a Nutanix Cluster Management v4.2 storage container.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_ext_id` (String) PE cluster UUID sent in the API `X-Cluster-Id` header during create.
- `name` (String) Unique storage-container name in the target cluster.

### Optional

- `affinity_host_ext_id` (String) Affinity host UUID for RF-1 containers.
- `cache_deduplication` (String) Cache deduplication status: `NONE`, `OFF`, or `ON`.
- `compression_delay_secs` (Number) Compression delay in seconds.
- `erasure_code` (String) Erasure coding status: `NONE`, `OFF`, or `ON`.
- `erasure_code_delay_secs` (Number) Erasure-code delay in seconds.
- `has_higher_ec_fault_domain_preference` (Boolean) Whether a higher erasure-code fault domain is preferred.
- `ignore_small_files` (Boolean) Pass `ignoreSmallFiles` during delete.
- `is_compression_enabled` (Boolean) Whether compression is enabled.
- `is_inline_ec_enabled` (Boolean) Whether inline erasure coding is enabled.
- `is_shared` (Boolean) Whether the container is shared across registered PE clusters. Immutable after creation.
- `is_software_encryption_enabled` (Boolean) Whether software encryption is enabled.
- `logical_advertised_capacity_bytes` (Number) Logical advertised capacity in bytes.
- `logical_explicit_reserved_capacity_bytes` (Number) Logical explicitly reserved capacity in bytes.
- `on_disk_dedup` (String) On-disk deduplication status: `NONE`, `OFF`, or `POST_PROCESS`.
- `replication_factor` (Number) Storage-container replication factor.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_name` (String) Owning cluster name.
- `container_ext_id` (String) Container external UUID.
- `ext_id` (String) Storage-container external UUID.
- `external_storage_ext_id` (String) External storage UUID.
- `id` (String) Terraform identity, equal to storage-container `extId`.
- `is_encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the container is encrypted.
- `is_internal` (Boolean) Whether Nutanix manages the container internally.
- `is_marked_for_removal` (Boolean) Whether the container is marked for removal by Nutanix.
- `is_nfs_whitelist_inherited` (Boolean) Whether the NFS whitelist is inherited globally.
- `logical_implicit_reserved_capacity_bytes` (Number) Logical implicit reservation in bytes.
- `max_capacity_bytes` (Number) Maximum physical capacity in bytes.
- `owner_ext_id` (String) Owner external UUID.
- `storage_pool_ext_id` (String) Storage pool external UUID.
